title: DevOps Engineer roadmap
summary: A guide to professional DevOps practices, from core Linux fundamentals to pipelines and infrastructure. Each phase builds concrete skills and portfolio pieces you can showcase to employers.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish solid Linux and version-control basics needed for any DevOps work.

milestones.title: Linux command line basics
milestones.outcome: Navigate, edit, and automate tasks on a Linux server confidently.

tasks.title: Read Linux filesystem hierarchy
tasks.description: Study the Linux Filesystem Hierarchy Standard on the official Linux Documentation Project.

tasks.title: Practice file permissions
tasks.description: Create files, change owners and permissions, and verify access using chmod, chown, and ls -l.

tasks.title: Write a bash script to monitor disk usage
tasks.description: Script checks /var/log and emails when usage exceeds 80%, then test it on a VM.

tasks.title: Reflect on common pitfalls
tasks.description: Write a short note on why sudo misuse can cause security issues.

tasks.title: Join Linux subreddit thread
tasks.description: Read recent discussions on /r/linux and comment with a question about system logs.

milestones.title: Git fundamentals and CI concepts
milestones.outcome: Use Git confidently and design simple CI workflows.

tasks.title: Complete freeCodeCamp Git basics
tasks.description: Finish the Git & GitHub module, focusing on branching and rebasing.

tasks.title: Create a repo with feature branches
tasks.description: Initialize a repo, add two feature branches, merge with pull requests, and resolve a conflict.

tasks.title: Set up a GitHub Actions CI for a Hello World app
tasks.description: Write a workflow that runs on push, installs dependencies, and runs unit tests.

tasks.title: Document CI pipeline steps
tasks.description: Write a markdown file explaining each job, trigger, and artifact in your workflow.

tasks.title: Connect with a DevOps meetup online
tasks.description: Attend a virtual meetup and ask about CI best practices.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Gain hands-on expertise with containers, orchestration, and IaC.

milestones.title: Docker containerization
milestones.outcome: Build, tag, and run multi-layer Docker images for any application.

tasks.title: Read Docker engine overview on docs.docker.com
tasks.description: Understand image layers, storage drivers, and networking basics.

tasks.title: Dockerize a Node.js app
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile, build the image, and run it with port mapping.

tasks.title: Practice multi-stage builds
tasks.description: Refactor the Dockerfile to use a builder stage and a minimal runtime stage.

tasks.title: Push image to Docker Hub
tasks.description: Create a Docker Hub account, tag the image, and push it publicly.

tasks.title: Reflect on image size reduction
tasks.description: Note how multi-stage builds cut size and why that matters in CI.

milestones.title: Kubernetes orchestration
milestones.outcome: Deploy and manage container workloads on a Kubernetes cluster.

tasks.title: Study Kubernetes concepts on Kubernetes.io
tasks.description: Read the concepts page covering Pods, Deployments, Services, and ConfigMaps.

tasks.title: Install Kind locally
tasks.description: Set up a local Kubernetes cluster with Kind and verify node status.

tasks.title: Deploy the Dockerized app to Kind
tasks.description: Create Deployment and Service YAML files, apply them, and test access via port-forward.

tasks.title: Scale the deployment to 3 replicas
tasks.description: Update the replica count, observe rollout status, and verify load balancing.

tasks.title: Join a Kubernetes Slack channel
tasks.description: Introduce yourself and ask a question about service discovery.

milestones.title: Infrastructure as code with Terraform
milestones.outcome: Provision cloud resources reproducibly using Terraform scripts.

tasks.title: Read Terraform getting started guide on terraform.io
tasks.description: Focus on providers, resources, and state management.

tasks.title: Write Terraform to create an AWS S3 bucket
tasks.description: Define provider, resource block, and run terraform init/apply.

tasks.title: Practice state back-ends with local file
tasks.description: Configure a local backend, make a change, and observe state file updates.

tasks.title: Add a lifecycle rule to the bucket
tasks.description: Use a lifecycle block to transition objects to Glacier after 30 days.

tasks.title: Reflect on drift detection
tasks.description: Write a brief note on why running terraform plan regularly matters.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate end-to-end DevOps pipelines.

milestones.title: CI/CD pipeline for a web app
milestones.outcome: Show a fully automated build, test, and deploy pipeline in a public repo.

tasks.title: Select a sample web app on GitHub
tasks.description: Fork a simple Flask or React starter project to your account.

tasks.title: Design pipeline stages on paper
tasks.description: Outline steps: lint, unit test, Docker build, push, and deploy to Kind.

tasks.title: Implement GitHub Actions workflow
tasks.description: Create .github/workflows/main.yml with jobs for each stage.

tasks.title: Add automated tests with pytest or Jest
tasks.description: Write at least three tests and ensure the pipeline fails on breakage.

tasks.title: Document the pipeline in README
tasks.description: Explain each job, required secrets, and how to trigger a manual run.

milestones.title: Containerised multi-service app
milestones.outcome: Deploy a multi-container application using Docker Compose and Kubernetes.

tasks.title: Choose a two-service demo (e.g., API + DB)
tasks.description: Clone a repo that includes a backend and a PostgreSQL database.

tasks.title: Write Docker Compose file for local dev
tasks.description: Define services, networks, and volumes; bring them up with docker compose up.

tasks.title: Convert Compose to Kubernetes manifests
tasks.description: Create Deployment and Service YAMLs for each component.

tasks.title: Deploy to Kind and verify inter-service communication
tasks.description: Use kubectl exec to query the API from the DB pod.

tasks.title: Share the repo and ask for feedback
tasks.description: Post the project link in a DevOps forum and note suggestions.

milestones.title: Terraform-defined infrastructure
milestones.outcome: Provision a full stack (VPC, compute, DB) on a cloud provider using Terraform.

tasks.title: Select a free-tier cloud (AWS or GCP)
tasks.description: Create an account and enable the free tier for compute resources.

tasks.title: Write Terraform modules for VPC and EC2
tasks.description: Separate reusable modules and reference them from a root configuration.

tasks.title: Add a PostgreSQL instance via Terraform
tasks.description: Define the RDS/CloudSQL resource with proper security groups.

tasks.title: Run terraform plan/apply and verify resources
tasks.description: Check the console and cloud console that resources are created.

tasks.title: Document architecture diagram in README
tasks.description: Create a simple diagram showing network layout and resource relationships.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced practices, monitoring, and job-search readiness.

milestones.title: Production-grade monitoring
milestones.outcome: Set up observability for services using open-source tools.

tasks.title: Read Prometheus fundamentals on prometheus.io
tasks.description: Focus on metrics model, exporters, and alerting rules.

tasks.title: Deploy Prometheus and Grafana on Kind
tasks.description: Use Helm charts to install both and configure a scrape target for the app.

tasks.title: Create a dashboard for request latency
tasks.description: Add a Grafana panel visualizing HTTP latency metrics from the app.

tasks.title: Set up an alert for high error rate
tasks.description: Write an alert rule that fires when 5xx responses exceed 2% for 5 minutes.

tasks.title: Reflect on alert fatigue mitigation
tasks.description: Write a short note on tuning thresholds and using on-call rotations.

milestones.title: Advanced GitOps and security
milestones.outcome: Apply GitOps principles and secure pipelines for enterprise environments.

tasks.title: Read Argo CD overview on argoproj.github.io
tasks.description: Understand declarative deployments from Git repositories.

tasks.title: Configure Argo CD to sync the Kubernetes app repo
tasks.description: Install Argo CD on Kind, add the repo, and enable auto-sync.

tasks.title: Add secret management with SOPS
tasks.description: Encrypt a Kubernetes secret file and configure decryption in the pipeline.

tasks.title: Document GitOps workflow in a wiki page
tasks.description: Explain how code changes flow to production via pull request and Argo CD.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior DevOps engineer on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Send a concise message asking for a quick chat about GitOps adoption.

milestones.title: Job and client readiness
milestones.outcome: Prepare interview materials, resume, and professional habits for hiring.

tasks.title: Update resume with quantified DevOps achievements
tasks.description: Add bullet points showing pipeline speed improvements and cost savings.

tasks.title: Create a 5-minute portfolio demo video
tasks.description: Record screen walkthrough of the CI/CD pipeline and Terraform infra.

tasks.title: Practice common DevOps interview questions
tasks.description: Answer at least ten questions aloud, focusing on troubleshooting and design trade-offs.

tasks.title: Set up a personal blog on GitHub Pages
tasks.description: Write a post describing one of your portfolio projects and lessons learned.

tasks.title: Join a local DevOps job board or community
tasks.description: Subscribe to a mailing list and attend one virtual hiring event.
